n: The region of East Africa as known by the Ancient Greeks and Romans.
a male given name, Azes, from Proto-Saka, the name of two Indo-Scythian kings
Azotus, the Greek name for an ancient Philistine city identified either with Gaza or Ashdod
Ashdod, identified in post-classical times by this name
